units.source_text: 金阁总是出现在女人和我之间、人生和我之间。

en.t: The Golden Pavilion always appeared between women and me, between life and me.

units.source_text: 于是，我的手一触及我想抓住的东西，那东西就立即变成灰，展望也完全化成沙漠了。

en.t: And so, the moment my hand touched anything I wanted to grasp, that thing at once turned to ash, and my prospects too were completely transformed into a desert.
